bullets.text: Led a team of 3 to build an AI Image Super-Resolution pipeline using PyTorch and TensorFlow on the DIV2K dataset, applying knowledge distillation from a teacher CNN to a 483K-parameter student model. • Achieved  92.7% SSIM and 28.5 dB PSNR  with real-time 1920×1080 inference, balancing accuracy against latency and parameter count. • Owned the full delivery cycle — preprocessing, training, benchmarking, and stakeholder demos — in Agile sprints with Intel mentors. • Maintained reproducible experiments and full GitHub documentation for fast iteration on architecture and loss-function changes.

projects.name: AgriBloom Agentic — AI Advisory for Indian Farmers    [ GitHub ]  — ET GenAI Hackathon 2026 Winning Project Python, PyTorch, EfficientNet-B4, LangGraph, Gemini Vision API, ChromaDB (RAG), Gradio

bullets.text: Built a 5-agent LangGraph pipeline (Orchestrator  →  Vision  →  Knowledge  →  Compliance  →  Output) that takes a crop photo and returns disease diagnosis with treatment in 10 Indian languages. • Trained an EfficientNet-B4 classifier on 91,000+ images across 92 disease classes; added a Gemini Vision fallback for any crop outside the trained set. • Implemented a deterministic compliance engine that blocks 46 CIB&RC-banned pesticides and enforces FSSAI MRL limits, with a full audit trail per check. • Integrated an ICAR-grounded RAG knowledge base in ChromaDB for advisory retrieval, plus a fertilizer NPK calculator, KVK helpline finder, and voice/PDF report output.
ZKProofAPI — Zero-Knowledge Proof Authentication Platform    [ GitHub ] Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, React, Docker, secp256k1 Schnorr Proofs

Built a production-grade SaaS platform providing ZKP authentication via REST API — Schnorr proofs on secp256k1 with sub-5ms verification, no blockchain required. • Developed full-stack infrastructure: FastAPI backend with 8 SQLAlchemy models, React developer dashboard (11 pages), Celery for async batch processing, and JavaScript + Python SDKs for 3-line client integration. • Shipped with 37 passing tests, Alembic migrations, Docker Compose deployment (API + PostgreSQL + Redis + Celery), and CI/CD via GitHub Actions — basis for the IEEE conference publication.
AI-Enhanced Cloud Resource Optimizer    [ GitHub ] Java, Spring Boot, React, MongoDB, Docker, Pinecone

Engineered a hybrid forecasting engine (EMA + Linear Regression + LSTM-inspired) processing 10,000+ metrics, delivering 40% simulated cost reduction via intelligent auto-scaling. • Implemented Pinecone vector search with 8-dimensional workload embeddings and cosine similarity for workload pattern classification. • Shipped a full-stack platform with 10 RESTful APIs, real-time dashboard, and one-command Docker deployment.
